summary_zh: 越南與EFTA四國於10月18日正式簽署VEFTA自貿協定，削減關稅並打開高購買力市場，但華商須符合原產地與可追溯要求，關稅與接單策略議題持續升溫。另越南國會討論增設7月27日為法定帶薪假（仍屬建議階段），可能影響生產排程與出勤；原料依賴進口的供應不穩問題亦持續出現。
summary_en: Vietnam signed the VEFTA FTA with four EFTA states on Oct 18, cutting tariffs but requiring rules-of-origin and traceability compliance. A proposed new paid holiday on July 27 (still a proposal) may affect scheduling, while import-dependent raw material supply remains a recurring pain.
